body:
AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 continuation (#8049–#8054): audited all five payload PRs against their full bodies, diffs, source issues and discussion. Applied and read back `audit:partial` on #8049, `audit:no-issue` on #8050, and `audit:complete` on #8051, #8053 and #8054. The #961 live-proof remainder is tracked by #15098/task #23811; #5119's later phase closes #8046's source issue. See [the #8049–#8054 audit record](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-8049-8054/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-8049-8054.md).

Cumulative progress: **226 valid PRs audited from 230 payload identifiers**; the four invalid identifiers are #7667, #7668, #7693 and #7694. **20 identifiers remain; next #8055.**
